# National stock index: weighted mean of the stock prices.
tsin_stock_index_value = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_steel has_variable = tsin_stock_steel } add = { value = var:tsin_stock_steel multiply = { value = tsin_company_levels_steel add = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_machinery has_variable = tsin_stock_machinery } add = { value = var:tsin_stock_machinery multiply = { value = tsin_company_levels_machinery add = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_textile has_variable = tsin_stock_textile } add = { value = var:tsin_stock_textile multiply = { value = tsin_company_levels_textile add = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_chemical has_variable = tsin_stock_chemical } add = { value = var:tsin_stock_chemical multiply = { value = tsin_company_levels_chemical add = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_railway has_variable = tsin_stock_railway } add = { value = var:tsin_stock_railway multiply = { value = tsin_company_levels_railway add = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = tsin_company_farm_machinery has_variable = tsin_stock_farm_machinery } add = { value = var:tsin_stock_farm_machinery multiply = { value = tsin_company_levels_farm_machinery add = 1 } } }
	if = {
		limit = { tsin_stock_index_weight > 0 }
		divide = tsin_stock_index_weight
	}
}
